mapper.sql: select id, table_name, parent_id, designation, image_id, search_count, sort, create_time from category
mapper.insert: insert into category (id, table_name, parent_id, designation, image_id, search_count, sort, create_time) values (#{id}, #{tableName}, #{parentId}, #{designation}, #{imageId}, #{searchCount}, #{sort}, #{createTime})
mapper.delete:
delete from category where id in
#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.designation AS name, c.search_count AS searchCount FROM category c WHERE c.table_name = #{tableName} AND c.parent_id IS NOT NULL AND c.parent_id != '' ORDER BY c.search_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.id, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.designation AS name, c.sort, CONCAT(#{imgBaseUrl}, im.stored_name) AS imageUrl FROM category c LEFT JOIN image_management im ON c.image_id = im.id WHERE c.table_name = #{tableName} ORDER BY c.parent_id ASC, c.sort ASC, c.create_time ASC

SELECT c.id, c.designation AS name, CONCAT(#{imgBaseUrl}, im.stored_name) AS imageUrl, c.sort FROM category c LEFT JOIN image_management im ON c.image_id = im.id WHERE c.table_name = #{tableName} AND (c.parent_id IS NULL OR c.parent_id = '') AND c.search_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY c.search_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.id, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.designation AS name, c.search_count AS searchCount, c.sort, c.create_time AS createTime, CONCAT(#{imgBaseUrl}, im.stored_name) AS imageUrl FROM category c LEFT JOIN image_management im ON c.image_id = im.id WHERE c.table_name = #{tableName} ORDER BY c.sort ASC, c.create_time ASC
SELECT id, designation, image_id, sort, parent_id FROM category WHERE table_name = 'ingredients' AND parent_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sort ASC, designation ASC
